titulo_es: Review cohesion, registration and frequent errors

texto: To draft a complaint and a brief report and to review cohesion and registration. **Jag ändrade sista delen** means «I've changed the last part.». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
